definitions.gloss: to replace; to substitute; to swap out
definitions.explanation: To exchange one thing for another, especially when updating or correcting something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧もの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{差|さ}し{替|か}える。
examples.english: Replace the photo with a new one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{替|か}えて{再提出|さいていしゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I replaced part of the document and resubmitted it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}→出演者：11340_shutsuensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{急遽|きゅうきょ}→急遽：12575_kyuukyo⟧{差|さ}し{替|か}えることになった。
examples.english: We had to suddenly replace the performer.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{替|か}える: to swap in a different photo
- ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{替|か}える: to replace a document with a revised one
- ⟦{出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}→出演者：11340_shutsuensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{替|か}える: to replace a performer
- {差|さ}し{替|か}え: the noun, a replacement (page, image, version)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取|と}り{替|か}える→取り替える：01252_torikaeru⟧: to replace something worn out or broken with a new one, or to exchange with someone (⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{替|か}える→取り替える：01252_torikaeru⟧).
- ⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}える→入れ替える：08227_irekaeru⟧: to swap positions or contents, to replace the contents as a whole (⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}える→入れ替える：08227_irekaeru⟧).
{差|さ}し{替|か}える is to pull one item out of a set (a page, a photo, a slot in a program) and put another in its place, usually to correct or update; common in publishing, business, and media.
